title: Phase 3.1 Information-Boundary Audit
method: Verified directly against vendor_kaggriculture/kaggriculture.py (VERIFIED_MECHANIC only where cited) -- not assumed from conceptual descriptions, per the brief's explicit instruction. Key evidence: kaggriculture.py lines 267-276 and 949-956 assign the SAME `farms`/`market`/`town` Python object references to every player's `state[i].observation`, while `state[i].observation.private = privates[i]` is a genuinely distinct per-player object built separately (_new_private() called once per player). This was already established in Phase 2.1 (docs/PHASE2_1_ARCHITECTURE.md section 1/10) and is re-verified here, not re-derived from scratch.

audit_table.representation: list of dicts, THIS PLAYER ONLY
float, EXACT, every turn -- a materially strong, previously under-exploited signal (see section below)

audit_table.information: Opponent tiles (crop type, planted_day, watered_today, animal type, fed/cared/fertilizer_available)
audit_table.representation: same tile-dict schema as own tiles -- full production state, not just presence/absence

audit_table.information: Opponent hires_today (hand count hired so far today)
audit_table.representation: int -- lets us infer hiring activity same-day

audit_table.source: obs['private'] is per-player; the opponent's private block is STRUCTURALLY ABSENT from this player's obs, not merely zeroed

audit_table.information: Opponent's SUBMITTED ACTION this turn (e.g. the literal string 'PLANT')
audit_table.source: obs never contains the opponent's action dict -- only the RESULTING state is visible
audit_table.representation: UNAVAILABLE DIRECTLY; an action can be INFERRED from a tile/position/money delta between two consecutive observations (see opponent_observation.py) -- this inference is a DERIVED signal, never to be logged or treated as directly observed

audit_table.source: does not exist in obs at decision time by construction
drawn from a per-day seeded RNG (VERIFIED, kaggriculture.py::_end_of_day, random.Random((seed*1_000_003)^day)) not exposed in advance
does not exist until the opponent's agent function is called on a future turn
DOCUMENTED (env.configuration['seed'] is cleared from config after read, per Phase 1 docs/01_mechanics_reference.md section 10) -- VERIFIED unavailable to any agent

key_finding_not_previously_exploited: Opponent's exact bank balance (money) and full tile-level production state (crop types, growth stages, watered/fed/cared flags, animal types) are BOTH fully public every turn -- richer than a naive 'only position is visible' assumption. What remains genuinely private is exactly three things: shed contents, seed counts, and carried inventory. This materially changes what a Phase 3.2+ opponent-behavior inference layer can legitimately use: production STATE can be read directly (no inference needed), while production ACTIVITY (what they bought/sold, what's in their shed) must be inferred from state deltas or is simply unavailable.

classification_legend.mechanically_observable: present directly in obs, no computation needed
classification_legend.derived_from_observable: computed from one or more mechanically-observable fields (e.g. inferred opponent action from a tile delta)
classification_legend.experimentally_inferred: not derivable from a single observation; requires historical pattern/statistics across many observations (none implemented in Phase 3.1 -- data-collection layer only)
classification_legend.unavailable: does not exist in obs and must never be synthesized
